title: 1RB1RF_1RC1LC can only halt at the left end
text: Lean proves that in the run of 1RB1RF_1RC1LC_1LD0LE_---1LE_1RF0LB_0RA1RE the tape left of the head never holds two 0s in a row, because the only transition that writes 0 and moves right always follows a written 1. With the known halting pattern, a halt would need E to read a 1 right next to the leftmost 1 of the tape. Regular descriptions of the tape tried so far do not close.
